title: Experimentation Starter
description: Build the mental model for running valid A/B tests: how to state a hypothesis, choose the right randomization unit, define primary and guardrail metrics, interpret significance correctly, and understand the difference between Type I and Type II errors before you ever run an experiment.
focus_concepts: TYPE I AND TYPE II ERRORS
outcomes: You'll state a testable null and alternative hypothesis, choose between user-level and session-level randomization, distinguish primary metrics from guardrail metrics, interpret a p-value and confidence interval correctly, and explain why reducing Type II error costs statistical power.
